description: Live E2E for the Beehave RQL module. Driven by scripts/extension_e2e.py (via scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor (with the pinned third-party Beehave addon installed from extension.json testAddon) and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (source, rows, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node3D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its source). The 'tools' then run every BeehaveGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise), followed by read-backs. Beehave classes are GDScript class_names: the core AddChild instantiates them, the beehave rows name them (scriptClass). 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated.

input.query: beehave.trees | where name == "BT" | get node | set props["tick_rate"] = 2, props["enabled"] = true
beehave.trees | select name enabled tickRate processThread actor nodeCount
beehave.nodes | where tree == "BT" | select name scriptClass kind depth path
